A '''steel mattock''' is the [[Steel equipment|steel]] [[mattock]], made by smithing an [[Iron Hoe|iron hoe]] with [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]]. It mines at speed 7 and has 3000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_mattock.json}}</ref>

As a [[mattock]], it works as both a shovel and a hoe, at a lower mining speed than the steel shovel or hoe.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[Smithing Upgrade Template|smithing upgrade template]] in the template slot, which is not used up. The recipe matches the base by item ID, so a iron mattock works as the base as well as an iron hoe; without the template the same base and alloy make a [[Steel Hoe|steel hoe]] instead.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/steel/mattock</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines both shovel and hoe blocks at speed 7.

In Matcha Flavoured, hoes also mine wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 1 damage with an attack speed of 2.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
